rev13Loss.droppedMaps: No substrate files were removed, but authored albedo RGB was collapsed to luminance. Motif stopped sampling the roughness and normal maps.
rev13Loss.proceduralChanges: Mica 28->26, microflake 85/0.16->92/0.19 with a narrower sparkle threshold, roughness 0.022-0.11->0.035-0.13, normal 0.32->0.36, iridescence 0.12->0.10.
rev13Loss.filtering: Texture importer stayed bilinear with mipmaps. Rev13 crystal additionally sampled scene color at 2.8 px distortion, which hid high-frequency substrate detail.

rev14Restoration: Same texture asset paths and hashes as rev12; authored RGB and rev12 tuning restored. Motif masks sample LOD0. Crystal transmission is 0.985 with 0.35 px refraction.
